5 sample questions

1. In Alabama, what is the youngest age to get a Stage I learner license?

  1. 14 years old
  2. 15 years old (correct answer)
  3. 16 years old
  4. 17 years old

Answer: B. In Alabama you can get a Stage I learner license at age 15, so you can practice for a year before you may drive alone at 16.

Alabama handbook, page 9.

2. In Alabama, unless a sign says otherwise, what is the speed limit in an urban district?

  1. 25 mph
  2. 30 mph (correct answer)
  3. 35 mph
  4. 40 mph

Answer: B. The Alabama speed limit in an urban district is 30 mph unless a sign shows a different limit, because towns have many people, driveways, and crossings.

Alabama handbook, page 60.

3. In Alabama, on a road with two or more lanes in your direction, what should you do when passing a stopped police car with flashing lights?

  1. Move out of the lane next to it if safe (correct answer)
  2. Stop behind it and wait
  3. Honk and keep your speed
  4. Speed up to pass it quickly

Answer: A. Under the Alabama Move Over law you must leave the lane closest to a stopped emergency vehicle when it is safe, and slow down if you cannot, to protect the people working there.

Alabama handbook, page 68.

4. Under Alabama's hands-free law, when is holding a phone while driving a violation?

  1. Only on interstate highways
  2. When you also drive poorly, like swerving (correct answer)
  3. Only between midnight and 6 a.m.
  4. Never, if you hold it below the window

Answer: B. Under the Alabama hands-free law, holding a phone while driving is a violation when you are also seen driving poorly, such as swerving or changing lanes without a signal, so it is safest to keep the phone out of your hand.

Alabama handbook, page 16.

5. In Alabama, who may sit beside a 15-year-old with a Stage I learner license while they drive?

  1. Any friend who has a license
  2. Any passenger age 16 or older
  3. A licensed driver age 18 or older
  4. A parent, guardian, or licensed driver age 21+ (correct answer)

Answer: D. A 15-year-old Alabama learner must drive with a parent, a legal guardian, or a licensed driver who is at least 21 in the front seat, because a new driver needs an experienced adult close by.

Alabama handbook, page 9.
